requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

944-4399-4518--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Planar Gate.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
944-4399-4518--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2893-4762-7941-8289.easyPrerequisites:
You control five or more Forests.
Fertilid has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2893-4762-7941-8289.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest enters, Syndicate Liquidators and Roiling Canopy trigger.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Resolve the Roiling Canopy trigger, giving Devoted Druid +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2893-4762-7941-8289.notes: Each loop, Devoted Druid will net +1/+1. This can let you gain more {G}, and that {G} can then fetch non-Forest basic lands with Fertilid.

751-6006-6965.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

985-5078-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2353-7687-7690-7691.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-7687-7690-7691.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
The Thing triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

586-864-2438-3125-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2438-3125-7396.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

3184-5231--192.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the legendary creature, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, Yomiji triggers, returning that card your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {R}.
Repeat.

803-2292-3413.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-7874-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-7874-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and The Immortal Weapons without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including The Immortal Weapons) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-7874-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-2457-5434-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

703-3680-7149.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Stunt Double dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Stunt Double enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Stunt Doubles into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Stunt Double tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-3680-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

149-2757-5356--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Barbed Servitor.
Barbed Servitor triggers, causing an opponent to lose that much life.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2757-5356--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

2558-2829-6705-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4484-4871-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4484-4871-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

586-2921-3497-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

222-527-4785-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4785-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-2210-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Mirrormade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

1479-5478-5700-5701-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-6529.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

575-5971-6261.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5971-6261.description:
Activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
When Bulwark Ox dies, Yedora triggers, returning Bulwark Ox from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Bulwark Ox enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bulwark Ox by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Bulwark Ox face-up.
Resolve the Bulwark Ox ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2511-4871-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur four times by sacrificing four Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

2-2034-4772-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2438-4812-5145.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

178-4365-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
178-4365-5361.description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Adeline trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating four token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Mondrak attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Adeline trigger, creating 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) 1/1 Human creature tokens tapped and attacking each opponent.

2210-2232-2751-3475-4768.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You have at least one non-Saga enchantment card in hand.
2210-2232-2751-3475-4768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and targeting it, copying The World Spell's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The World Spell's trigger, putting Mirrormade and any non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Choose to have Mirrormade enter the battlefield as a copy of The World Spell, with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Mirrormade triggers once, and Cloudstone Curio and Altar of the Brood each trigger twice.
Resolve both Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mirrormade and any other non-Saga enchantment from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mirrormade trigger, putting it and the non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

1486-2466-3525.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2089.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2034-2089.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Symmetry Matrix.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1109-2178-2228.notablePrerequisites: A player controls another creature with toughness equal to 1.
1109-2178-2228.description:
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on target creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness, triggering Hapatra and Skeleton Ship.
Resolve the Hapatra trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Skeleton Ship trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

262-643-991.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Benthicore.
Benthicore does not have summoning sickness.
262-643-991.description:
Activate Benthicore by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental tokens with haste that have all creature types due to Maskwood Nexus.
Activate Benthicore by tapping two Elemental tokens, untapping Benthicore.
Repeat.

1887-3096-3189.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1887-3096-3189.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for any five other cards, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library and losing half your life, rounded up.
Cast Jace by paying {1}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Jace's second loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from him, drawing seven cards and win the game.

1656-3693-4899.notablePrerequisites: The combined mana value of cards in your library is greater than or equal to the sum of your opponents' life totals.
1656-3693-4899.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze's using Phyrexian Devourer's ability by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Necrotic Ooze equal to the card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 until the number of +1/+1 counters on Necrotic Ooze is at least equal to the sum of your opponents' life totals.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Walking Ballista's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 until all opponents have taken lethal damage.
